versions.content: The function Fr_GetGlobalTime shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Read the current global FlexRay time and write it to the output parameters Fr_CyclePtr and Fr_MacrotickPtr. 2. Return E_OK.
